_comment: The control panels of ebFRET's main window (MainWindow.m), declared rather than hand-drawn. Panel titles are the MATLAB uipanel titles; the window frames each panel and draws the plots between them. Tables are ChiSurf additions (the MATLAB window has none): the series list drives Select Series, the state table shows the selected model.

sections.description: The time series shown in the Time Series panel (ebFRET's IndexControl: edit box and slider). The slider's range is the number of loaded series.

sections.label: Min
sections.description: First frame of the current series that enters the analysis. Changing the crop resets this series' result.

sections.label: Max
sections.description: Last frame of the current series that enters the analysis. Frames past it are drawn dashed.

sections.label: Exclude
sections.description: Leave the current series out of the analysis entirely.
The number of states whose model the Ensemble panel and the Viterbi overlay show. Its range is States Min to Max.

sections.label: States
sections.description: All: analyse every number of states from Min to Max. Current: only the one selected in Select States.

sections.label: Restarts
sections.description: Re-initialisations of each series' variational fit per iteration. 0 continues from the last result, 1 adds an uninformative start, more add random starts drawn from the prior. 2 suffices for most datasets.

sections.label: Precision
sections.description: Convergence threshold of the lower bound, relative. 1e-3 for exploring, 1e-6 for results you publish.

buttons.label: Run
buttons.description: Start the empirical-Bayes analysis on the backend.

buttons.label: Reset
buttons.description: Discard the result of All/Current and re-guess its prior.

sections.description: Every loaded series; selecting one shows it (Select Series).

columns.title: Group
columns.tooltip: One group per load that kept the loaded series

columns.title: Lower bound
columns.tooltip: Variational lower bound of this series under the selected model

sections.description: The selected model per state, as in the Analysis Summary export: occupancy, center, noise and dwell time of the prior.

columns.label: Occupancy
columns.description: Fraction of analysed frames in this state

columns.label: Center
columns.description: Prior mean of the state's signal

columns.label: Dwell
columns.description: Most likely dwell time in frames
